prompt: What's our policy on password rotation?

assertions.name: search_executed
assertions.check: skill runs 'python -m kgent search' with relevant query
assertions.verification: response contains 'python -m kgent search' with password/rotation terms

assertions.name: documents_read
assertions.check: skill reads 2-5 relevant documents using 'python -m kgent read'
assertions.verification: response contains 'python -m kgent read' calls for search results

assertions.name: claims_cited
assertions.check: every factual claim in the answer has a source citation
assertions.verification: answer section contains inline citations like [Document Title](url)

assertions.name: native_url_citations
assertions.check: citations use native URLs (https://...), not kgent:// URIs
assertions.verification: all URLs in the answer/citations start with 'https://' and none with 'kgent://'

assertions.name: sources_section
assertions.check: answer has a Sources section listing all cited documents
assertions.verification: response contains a 'Sources:' or '## Sources' section with listed documents

assertions.name: no_fabrication
assertions.check: skill does not fabricate password policy details not from search results
assertions.verification: policy details are attributed to specific documents, not stated as general knowledge
